33538492.title: mRNA vaccine technology and COVID-19
33538492.abstract: Review of mRNA vaccine platforms. Lipid nanoparticle delivery enables rapid clinical translation of mRNA vaccines against SARS-CoV-2. Immunogenicity and reactogenicity profiles support continued booster strategies.

34390567.title: Safety and efficacy of an mRNA-based vaccine against SARS-CoV-2: a phase 3 trial
34390567.abstract: A two-dose regimen of mRNA-1273 gave 94.1% vaccine efficacy against symptomatic COVID-19. Local and systemic reactogenicity was transient, and no safety concerns were identified through median 2 months of follow-up.

33301712.title: Durability of humoral and cellular immunity following BNT162b2 vaccination
33301712.abstract: Spike-specific memory B cells and CD8+ T cells persisted for at least six months after the second dose of BNT162b2. Neutralizing titers against variants of concern waned gradually, supporting boosters.

34452845.title: T-cell responses to mRNA vaccination in immunocompromised patients
34452845.abstract: Patients on anti-CD20 therapy mounted blunted spike-specific T-cell responses after two mRNA doses, with a third dose partially restoring immunity. Cellular correlates inform dosing schedules for vulnerable populations.

35690234.title: Omicron variant immune escape and booster vaccination
35690234.abstract: Omicron subvariants showed substantial escape from neutralizing antibodies elicited by primary vaccination. Booster doses restored neutralization to levels associated with protection against severe disease.

34567890.title: Long COVID: epidemiology, mechanisms, and therapeutic outlook
34567890.abstract: Post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 affect multiple organ systems, with fatigue and cognitive dysfunction most common. Proposed mechanisms include viral persistence, autoimmunity, and dysautonomia, guiding ongoing trials.

32015508.title: CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing advances
32015508.abstract: Recent advances in CRISPR genome editing. Engineered Cas9 variants with reduced off-target activity broaden therapeutic applicability. Base editing enables precise single-nucleotide changes without double-strand breaks.

30446904.title: Programmable base editing of T cells to treat cancer
30446904.abstract: Adenine base editing disrupted TCR and PDCD1 loci in primary human T cells without double-strand breaks, enabling allogeneic CAR-T therapies. Edited cells showed potent antitumor activity in xenograft models.

33919832.title: Prime editing enables precise genome modification in human cells
33919832.abstract: Prime editing combines a Cas9 nickase with a reverse transcriptase to install all 12 base-to-base conversions, insertions, and deletions. Off-target effects were minimal across evaluated genomic sites.

31570789.title: In vivo CRISPR editing of the liver to lower cholesterol
31570789.abstract: Lipid nanoparticle delivery of CRISPR-Cas9 to hepatocytes durably knocked down PCSK9, reducing circulating LDL cholesterol by 60% in nonhuman primates. Findings support one-shot genome therapies for hyperlipidemia.

32845678.title: Single-cell CRISPR screens map gene regulatory networks
32845678.abstract: Perturb-seq coupled pooled CRISPR screens with single-cell RNA sequencing to dissect transcriptional responses to loss of each transcription factor. Maps revealed lineage-specific regulatory circuits.

35081234.title: Genome-wide association study of inflammatory bowel disease identifies 38 new loci
35081234.abstract: A meta-analysis of 50,000 cases and 60,000 controls identified 38 novel IBD risk loci, enriching for genes involved in innate immunity and barrier function. Fine-mapping prioritized candidate causal variants.

30987654.title: Pembrolizumab versus chemotherapy for advanced non-small-cell lung cancer
30987654.abstract: First-line pembrolizumab improved overall survival versus platinum chemotherapy in PD-L1-high NSCLC. High tumor mutational burden correlated with response, supporting biomarker-guided immunotherapy.

32101234.title: Liquid biopsy for early cancer detection using circulating tumor DNA
32101234.abstract: A multi-cancer early detection test combining methylation and mutation signals in cell-free DNA achieved 99% specificity and localized over 50 cancer types. Sensitivity increased with stage and tumor type.

33104567.title: Tumor microenvironment and resistance to immune checkpoint blockade
33104567.abstract: Resistance to checkpoint inhibitors arises through tumor-intrinsic loss of antigen presentation, suppressive myeloid programs, and stromal barriers. Combining immunotherapy with stromal targeting may overcome resistance.

31678901.title: CAR-T cell therapy for relapsed B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
31678901.abstract: CD19-directed CAR-T cells achieved complete remission in 81% of pediatric patients with relapsed B-ALL. Cytokine release syndrome and neurotoxicity were manageable with tocilizumab and corticosteroids.

34234567.title: Adjuvant immunotherapy in resected melanoma: long-term outcomes
34234567.abstract: Adjuvant anti-PD-1 therapy prolonged recurrence-free survival in resected stage III melanoma at 4-year follow-up. Benefit was maintained across BRAF-mutant and wild-type subgroups.

33590123.title: Synthetic lethality of PARP inhibitors in BRCA-mutant ovarian cancer
33590123.abstract: Maintenance olaparib prolonged progression-free survival in newly diagnosed BRCA-mutated ovarian cancer. Homologous recombination deficiency score identified a broader responder population.

34876543.title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals tumor heterogeneity in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
34876543.abstract: Spatial profiling of pancreatic tumors mapped stromal niches associated with therapy resistance. Keratin-positive basal-like tumor cells spatially co-localized with immunosuppressive macrophages.

30971806.title: Deep learning in medical imaging
30971806.abstract: Survey of deep learning for radiology. Convolutional networks match radiologists in chest radiograph triage, while transformer architectures extend multimodal analysis. Validation gaps remain for generalization.

32451098.title: An autonomous AI system for diabetic retinopathy screening
32451098.abstract: A deep learning system achieved ophthalmologist-level sensitivity and specificity for referable diabetic retinopathy in retinal fundus images. Prospective deployment in clinics reduced wait times for specialists.

33245678.title: Foundation models for clinical text: a benchmark on radiology reports
33245678.abstract: Transformer language models pretrained on radiology reports outperformed general-domain models on impression generation and findings extraction. Bias audits flagged demographic performance gaps requiring mitigation.

31789012.title: AI-assisted interpretation of screening mammography
31789012.abstract: A deep learning assistant reduced false positives and false negatives when used alongside radiologists in mammography screening. Reading time increased modestly, suggesting feasible clinical integration.

34509876.title: Federated learning for multicenter medical imaging without data sharing
34509876.abstract: A federated learning framework trained tumor segmentation models across hospitals without exchanging patient images. Performance matched centralized training while preserving privacy and regulatory compliance.

32987654.title: Deep learning for prediction of acute kidney injury from electronic health records
32987654.abstract: A recurrent neural network predicted acute kidney injury 48 hours in advance with an AUC of 0.87. Prospective evaluation demonstrated reduced severity when clinicians acted on alerts.

35901234.title: Generative models for synthetic medical image augmentation
35901234.abstract: Diffusion-based generative models produced synthetic CT images that improved rare-disease segmentation performance when used for augmentation. Quality audits confirmed no leakage of identifiable features.

31570790.title: SGLT2 inhibitors and cardiovascular outcomes in heart failure
31570790.abstract: Dapagliflozin reduced the composite of worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death in patients with preserved and reduced ejection fraction. Benefits appeared within weeks of treatment initiation.

32112345.title: Efficacy and safety of PCSK9 inhibitors in high-risk patients
32112345.abstract: Alirocumab lowered LDL cholesterol by 56% and reduced major adverse cardiovascular events in patients with recent acute coronary syndrome. Injection-site reactions were the most common adverse event.

32456789.title: Transcatheter aortic valve replacement in low-risk patients
32456789.abstract: Transfemoral TAVR with self-expanding valves was noninferior to surgery for severe aortic stenosis in low-risk patients at 2 years. Stroke and mortality rates were low in both groups.

30890123.title: Atrial fibrillation ablation versus antiarrhythmic drug therapy
30890123.abstract: Catheter ablation improved freedom from atrial fibrillation and quality of life compared with antiarrhythmic drugs. Pulmonary vein isolation was the dominant ablation strategy.

33678901.title: Wearable device detection of atrial fibrillation in a large ambulatory cohort
33678901.abstract: A photoplethysmography-based smartwatch algorithm flagged atrial fibrillation with 84% positive predictive value in a cohort of over 400,000 participants. Confirmation by clinician review enabled early anticoagulation.

31901234.title: Regional differences in ST-elevation myocardial infarction care and outcomes
31901234.abstract: Door-to-balloon times varied markedly across regions, with rural hospitals exhibiting longer delays. Implementation of regional triage protocols reduced mortality in transferred STEMI patients.

32245678.title: Lecanemab in early Alzheimer's disease: a phase 3 trial
32245678.abstract: Lecanemab, an anti-amyloid monoclonal antibody, slowed cognitive decline by 27% in early Alzheimer's disease. Amyloid-related imaging abnormalities occurred in 13% of treated patients.

31567890.title: Tau pathology and cognitive decline in early Alzheimer's disease
31567890.abstract: PET imaging of tau pathology correlated more strongly with cognitive decline than amyloid burden. Regional tau spread followed a stereotyped anatomical pattern consistent with Braak staging.

30890124.title: Blood-based biomarkers for early detection of Alzheimer's disease
30890124.abstract: Plasma phosphorylated tau 217 distinguished amyloid-positive individuals with over 90% accuracy. Performance was robust across demographic groups and may enable population-scale screening.

32890123.title: Sleep disruption accelerates amyloid and tau accumulation
32890123.abstract: Reduced slow-wave sleep was associated with greater amyloid deposition and cerebrospinal fluid tau. Interventions targeting sleep architecture may modify Alzheimer's risk trajectories.

31034567.title: Deep brain stimulation for treatment-resistant depression
31034567.abstract: Subcallosal cingulate deep brain stimulation produced sustained antidepressant response in over half of participants with treatment-resistant depression. Response prediction relied on tractography-based targeting.

34123456.title: Microglia and synaptic pruning in neurodegenerative disease
34123456.abstract: Single-cell profiling of microglia identified disease-associated substates that drive excessive synaptic pruning in models of Alzheimer's disease. Complement C3 tagging marked vulnerable synapses.

32167890.title: Continuous glucose monitoring in adults with type 1 diabetes
32167890.abstract: Real-time continuous glucose monitoring improved glycemic control in adults with type 1 diabetes using multiple daily injections. Time in range increased while hypoglycemia decreased.

31345678.title: Once-weekly semaglutide in adults with type 2 diabetes
31345678.abstract: Once-weekly subcutaneous semaglutide reduced HbA1c by 1.5% and body weight by 4.5 kg in type 2 diabetes. Gastrointestinal adverse events were dose-dependent and generally transient.

33098765.title: Closed-loop insulin delivery systems in pediatric type 1 diabetes
33098765.abstract: Hybrid closed-loop systems using deep-learning-enhanced dosing algorithms increased time-in-range to 70% in children with type 1 diabetes. Overnight glycemic control improved most markedly.

33890123.title: Tirzepatide versus semaglutide for obesity: a phase 3 trial
33890123.abstract: Dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist tirzepatide achieved 20% mean weight loss, exceeding semaglutide. The trial enrolled adults with obesity without diabetes, broadening indications.

34567812.title: Metabolic surgery versus medical therapy for type 2 diabetes at 10 years
34567812.abstract: Roux-en-Y gastric bypass maintained higher diabetes remission rates than medical therapy at 10-year follow-up. Durability was greatest in patients with shorter disease duration at surgery.

31987654.title: Islet transplantation and beta-cell replacement strategies
31987654.abstract: Stem-cell-derived islets achieved insulin independence in a subset of recipients. Immunomodulatory protocols and encapsulation devices are being optimized to reduce the need for systemic immunosuppression.

32304567.title: Malaria vaccine RTS,S/AS01 in African children: 4-year follow-up
32304567.abstract: RTS,S/AS01 vaccination prevented approximately 30% of malaria cases over 4 years. Seasonal administration and booster dosing improved efficacy in high-transmission settings.

31789013.title: Antibiotic stewardship and resistance in gram-negative bloodstream infections
31789013.abstract: A stewardship bundle reduced broad-spectrum antibiotic use by 40% and carbapenem resistance rates without increasing mortality. Decision support tools targeting empiric therapy drove the effect.

32901234.title: Tuberculosis diagnostics: a systematic review of molecular tests
32901234.abstract: Xpert MTB/RIF Ultra increased tuberculosis case detection in people living with HIV. Molecular assays shortened time to treatment initiation compared with smear microscopy.

33456789.title: Dengue vaccine efficacy across serostatus groups
33456789.abstract: Tetravalent dengue vaccine showed high efficacy in seropositive individuals but elevated hospitalization risk in seronegative children, informing age- and serostatus-based vaccination policy.

31654321.title: Global burden of cardiovascular disease: a GBD analysis
31654321.abstract: Cardiovascular disease remained the leading global cause of death. Ischemic heart disease and stroke dominated disability-adjusted life-years, with rising prevalence in low-income regions.

32789012.title: Social determinants of health and life expectancy in US counties
32789012.abstract: County-level life expectancy varied by over 20 years and correlated with income, education, and access to care. Targeted interventions on smoking and hypertension closed gaps most rapidly.

34012345.title: Vaccine hesitancy and measles resurgence in high-income countries
34012345.abstract: Subnational declines in measles-mumps-rubella coverage correlated with vaccine hesitancy. Outbreak modeling identified under-immunized communities as primary drivers of resurgence.

31145678.title: Ketamine versus electroconvulsive therapy for treatment-resistant depression
31145678.abstract: Intravenous ketamine produced rapid antidepressant effects comparable to electroconvulsive therapy at 2 weeks. Dissociative side effects were transient and well-tolerated.

32567890.title: Digital cognitive behavioral therapy for anxiety in young adults
32567890.abstract: A guided digital CBT program reduced anxiety symptoms in young adults with moderate effect sizes. Engagement declined without human coaching support, highlighting a scalability tradeoff.

33401234.title: Psilocybin-assisted therapy for major depressive disorder
33401234.abstract: Two supervised psilocybin sessions produced large reductions in depressive symptoms that persisted at 4 weeks. Hallucinogenic and cardiovascular effects necessitated controlled settings.

30812345.title: Endovascular thrombectomy for stroke with large-core infarcts
30812345.abstract: Thrombectomy extended the benefit window to 24 hours in patients with favorable imaging profiles. Functional independence at 90 days doubled compared with medical management.

32290123.title: Tenecteplase versus alteplase for acute ischemic stroke
32290123.abstract: Tenecteplase was noninferior to alteplase for disability outcomes after ischemic stroke, with fewer systemic bleeding events. Single-bolus administration offers logistical advantages.

33678902.title: Mobile stroke units and prehospital thrombolysis: a randomized trial
33678902.abstract: Mobile stroke units reduced time to thrombolysis and improved 90-day functional outcomes in urban settings. Cost-effectiveness depended on regional case volume.

31701234.title: Tofacitinib in ulcerative colitis: maintenance therapy outcomes
31701234.abstract: Tofacitinib maintained remission in ulcerative colitis through 52 weeks. Herpes zoster reactivation was more frequent than with placebo, prompting vaccination guidance.

32467890.title: Autoantibody profiling predicts progression to rheumatoid arthritis
32467890.abstract: Multiplexed autoantibody profiling identified individuals with arthralgia who progressed to rheumatoid arthritis. Citrullinated protein-directed responses preceded clinical onset by years.

33123456.title: Dialysis initiation timing in older adults with advanced kidney disease
33123456.abstract: Early versus delayed dialysis initiation showed no difference in survival among older adults. Patient-reported outcomes favored a symptom-guided approach over eGFR thresholds.

31987655.title: Direct-acting antivirals for hepatitis C: real-world outcomes
31987655.abstract: Sofosbuvir-velpatasvir achieved sustained virologic response in 97% of patients with chronic hepatitis C in routine practice. Retreatments of decompensated cirrhosis remained challenging.

32678901.title: Gene therapy for spinal muscular atrophy: long-term outcomes
32678901.abstract: Onasemnogene abeparvovec improved motor milestones in children with spinal muscular atrophy, with benefits sustained through 5 years. Elevated hepatic enzymes required corticosteroid management.

31456789.title: Exome sequencing in undiagnosed pediatric disorders increases diagnostic yield
31456789.abstract: Trio exome sequencing yielded diagnoses in 35% of children with previously undiagnosed developmental disorders. Findings informed management changes including targeted therapies.

33290123.title: CRISPR therapy for sickle cell disease: a phase 1/2 trial
33290123.abstract: Exagamglogene autotemcel eliminated vaso-occlusive crises in sickle cell disease through BCL11A disruption in hematopoietic stem cells. Neutrophil recovery was the principal safety consideration.

34678901.title: Newborn genomic sequencing and incidental findings: parental perspectives
34678901.abstract: Parents largely favored receiving actionable incidental findings from newborn sequencing. Carrier and pharmacogenomic results informed anticipatory guidance in a diverse cohort.

32901235.title: Senolytics and frailty in older adults: a pilot trial
32901235.abstract: A senolytic combination of dasatinib and quercetin reduced physical dysfunction in small cohorts of older adults. Larger trials are needed to confirm geroscience-guided interventions.

33789012.title: Caloric restriction and biomarkers of aging in nonhuman primates
33789012.abstract: Moderate caloric restriction improved metabolic and inflammatory biomarkers in rhesus monkeys but did not extend maximal lifespan. Effects on brain atrophy were modest.

31301234.title: Pharmacogenomics of warfarin dosing: a randomized trial
31301234.abstract: Genotype-guided warfarin dosing did not improve time in therapeutic range compared with clinical algorithms. Subgroup analyses suggested benefit in CYP2C9 variant carriers.

32654321.title: Real-world safety of immune checkpoint inhibitors: a multinational cohort
32654321.abstract: Immune-related adverse events were documented in 35% of patients on checkpoint inhibitors, with endocrine and gastrointestinal events most common. Early recognition reduced discontinuation.

32167891.title: Enhanced recovery after surgery in colorectal cancer resection
32167891.abstract: Enhanced recovery pathways shortened hospital stay and reduced complications after colorectal resection. Early mobilization and fluid restriction were the most impactful components.

31098765.title: Perioperative outcomes of robotic versus open surgery for prostate cancer
31098765.abstract: Robotic-assisted radical prostatectomy was associated with shorter hospital stay and fewer transfusions than open surgery. Oncologic and functional outcomes were similar at 2 years.

31678902.title: Biologics for severe eosinophilic asthma: a network meta-analysis
31678902.abstract: Anti-IL-5 biologics reduced exacerbations in severe eosinophilic asthma, with benralizumab and mepolizumab showing comparable efficacy. Biomarker-guided selection improved cost-effectiveness.

32890124.title: Long-term oxygen therapy in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
32890124.abstract: Ambulatory oxygen improved exercise tolerance but did not change mortality in COPD patients with moderate resting hypoxemia. Beneficiaries were those with exertional desaturation.
